title: RefundRequested / RefundApproved / RefundRejected / RefundWaiting / RefundNotReviewed v1 payload
description: A staff refund to a rider (ADR 0018 part A, issue #512): requested and waiting for a confirmation, approved (by a confirmer, or at once for the super admin's own) and waiting for the execution, or rejected by a confirmer. state is the refund's state after the change. RefundWaiting: the request has waited the service's reminder_hours for a confirmation (a case in the problem queue reminds the confirmers, once). RefundNotReviewed: it waited close_after_days and closed without money moving.
